card.name: How often to monitor
card.fires_on: Words that set how often something is checked, such as frequently, weekly, twice or at least, right after a verb like monitor or a test name. Mostly in lab-monitoring instructions.

modes.label: Frequency word after monitor
modes.description: An adverb like frequently or weekly directly after monitor plus a lab test or organ function.
modes.example: Monitor more<< frequently>> for patients with Grade 3 or

modes.label: Partway through a frequency phrase
modes.description: A word inside a phrase giving the number or minimum of checks, such as twice weekly or at least once a year.
modes.example: Increase platelet monitoring to<< twice>> weekly.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about intervals and frequency of checks.
card.plain: It lights up where the text says how often a test or check should be repeated.
